reason: The only cited evidence (E1) shows that HPT + annealing refines grains and improves ductility in a single-phase FCC CoCrNi medium entropy alloy, but it provides no data on crack arrest, caloric response, or the behaviour of the chemically and structurally distinct (MnNiSi)0.62(FeCoGe)0.38 alloy. The key premises about mechanical integrity improvement and caloric retention are therefore unsupported by the cited passage.
premises: HPT + annealing refines grain structure and produces a dual-phase/partially recrystallized microstructure in a high-entropy alloy
Such a refined heterogeneous microstructure arrests cracks and improves mechanical integrity (strength, toughness)
The caloric transformation mechanism can survive the annealing treatment largely intact
The specific alloy (MnNiSi)0.62(FeCoGe)0.38 will respond to HPT + annealing similarly to the CoCrNi medium entropy alloy
